messages:
matt: Hey - quick pause request. We pushed model_v13 to 10% EU+NA earlier and ramped to 20% EU at 10:12UTC. EU p95 latency jumped ~180ms -> 400ms on the auth path. Can we hold at 20% and gate the next bump?
priya: ack, pausing any further percent ramps. Do we need to flip the flag back to 10% or just stop the scheduled ramp?
sam: what's the current flag name? I can flip if we prefer a quick rollback.
matt: flag is `feature:model_v13_canary_pct`. We have a scheduled task to `increase to 30% at 11:00`. I'll cancel that and hold. If we need a rollback it's `toggle feature:model_v13_canary_pct --set 10` (internal CLI).
lia: can we use region split instead of global? i.e., freeze EU, continue NA?
priya: yes, freezing EU is preferable. NA p95 looks fine.
oncall-bot: ALERT #2341: EU inference-hosts (cluster-eu-01) CPU spike at 11:05 UTC. Related errors: `kvcache-miss` spikes 4x. Link: https://sentry.redwood.ai/issue/2341
eileen: is there a health gate? what's the cutoff to rollback to v12 fully? need to document for release board.
matt: Gate we agreed: p95 latency + error rate. Thresholds: p95 > 300ms for 10m OR error rate > 0.5% -> rollback. I will annotate the rollout ticket.
sam: I'll watch the dashboard and set a temporary alert: EU p95 > 300ms -> page oncall. Also will add a composite check for `kvcache-miss` rate.
priya: Can we limit new requests to NA-only for the 20% slice? How do we set region split: `feature:model_v13_canary_pct --regions na:20,eu:10`?
matt: exactly. I'll reconfigure to `na:20 eu:10` to reduce EU load. I'll also add `fallback_model: v12` in routing for EU if errors exceed threshold.
eileen: please post the final commands here and mark the rollout paused in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
matt: done. Canceled scheduled ramp, updated flag: `feature:model_v13_canary_pct -> na:20 eu:10`. Added fallback. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-987
priya: thanks — keep me posted.
sam: on it, will confirm when alerts are in place.
oncall-bot: NOTE: Incident created and assigned to `sam` for monitoring.
matt: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if metrics stabilize; otherwise we rollback to v12 and run perf-profile on eu cluster.
